caption: The drawing features a stylized yellow and black bird with a black beak, black eye markings, and a fan-shaped yellow-and-red tail perched on a curved, decorative stem. The bird faces left and is next to a large, red, curving flower with yellow detailing and leaves. Additional leaf-like shapes in yellow and black, as well as a small yellow bud, are present on black stems below and around the bird. To the right of the bird, there is a red sun with triangular rays and a yellow center. There is a plant with a long, vertical stem in the center below the bird, which has symmetrical black leaves. The base of the drawing is a red half-oval shape with yellow semi-circular accents underneath, all set against a beige background. The composition is flat and stylized, using solid colors without shading, with clear black outlines around most elements. The text at the bottom reads: “FROM A SGRAFFITO PLATE 1812.”
title: Plate 14: From the Portfolio "Folk Art of Rural Pennsylvania"
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
